# konnect_ai_gateway_cost_management_tags (Resource)

AIGatewayCostManagementTags Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_ai_gateway_cost_management_tags" "my_aigatewaycostmanagementtags" {
  headers = [
    {
      name    = "my-tenant-id"
      tag_key = "tenant"
    }
  ]
  labels = {
    key = "value"
  }
  managed_by = {
    key = "value"
  }
  prefixes = [
    {
      name = "my-co"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `headers` (Attributes List) Request headers captured as cost tags. Each header is mapped to one tag key.
Together with `prefixes`, at most 32 entries are allowed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--headers))
- `prefixes` (Attributes List) Request header prefixes. A request header matches a prefix when its name is the prefix
followed by `-` and a remainder, compared case-insensitively. For example, the prefix
`my-co` matches `my-co-region` but not `my-company`. The remainder becomes the tag key,
so `my-co-region` is captured as the tag `region`. Headers whose remainder is not a
valid tag key (see the `tag_key` pattern, at most 128 characters) produce no tag and
are skipped; capture continues for the remaining headers.
Headers starting with `ai-cost-` are always captured, in addition to any configured here.
Together with `headers`, at most 32 entries are allowed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--prefixes))

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) Public labels store information about an entity that can be used for filtering a list of objects.

Public labels are intended to store **PUBLIC** metadata. 

Keys must be of length 1-63 characters, and cannot start with "kong", "konnect", "mesh", "kic", or "_".
- `managed_by` (Map of String) Stores information about what manages this entity, such as the tool or system responsible for its lifecycle (for example, `terraform`).

Keys must be 1–63 characters long and start with an alphanumeric character.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity update date.

<a id="nestedatt--headers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `headers`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Name of the request header. Cannot be a credential header, such as `authorization`,
`x-api-key` or `cookie`. Names are compared case-insensitively.
Not Null
- `tag_key` (String) Key of the cost tag the header value is stored under. Not Null


<a id="nestedatt--prefixes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `prefixes`

Optional:

- `name` (String) Header prefix with at least two dash-separated segments. Cannot be a credential
header name, nor a prefix of one, such as `x-goog` for `x-goog-api-key`. Credential
headers are never captured, even when they match a configured prefix. Prefixes are
compared case-insensitively.
Not Null
